heard: These were the sons of Israel, Reuben, Sinai, and Levi, Judah Issachar, Zebulun, Dan, Joseph, Benjamin, Naphtali Gad and Asher stood as one, Judah had five sons in all Ere Onan and Shelah there, Tamar, Bor, Perez and Zerah Hey, Lisa, Father, this is mine. And this is my Father's shalom. This is my Father's shalom, the line of Judah's name.
